heading: PROTECT AND PRESERVE FLORIDA'S FUTURE.
text: Standing up for our farms, protecting our water, defending consumers, and preserving the Florida we love.

heading: MEET JOEY
text: I'm Joey Mendoza Atkins, and I am running for Florida’s Commissioner of Agriculture because I believe government should protect the people—not special interests.

heading: MEET JOEY
text: As a trial attorney, my legal practice has focused on representing individuals and families in civil litigation. Some of my proudest work stems from my work in providing legal aid to migrant farmworkers and DACA recipients.

heading: MEET JOEY
text: My professional experience has included both the practice of law and work in international economic development, giving me experience across the legal, nonprofit, public, and private sectors.

heading: MEET JOEY
text: In addition to legal and policy experience, I am a sports agent, representing college and professional athletes while negotiating contracts and career opportunities.

heading: MEET JOEY
text: I am so thankful to have the endorsement of the Florida Democratic Agricultural Caucus among others. In their words:

heading: MEET JOEY
text: “Mendoza Atkins's responses demonstrate a strong policy background and two decades of multi-sector experience spanning legal aid for Florida migrant farmworkers, environmental management, economic development, and civil litigation. Holding a Master’s degree in environmental management and having engaged in policy work with the UN Global Compact, he brings deep expertise in regulatory structures, consumer protections, and rural economic policy.” – Dr. John Capece, FL Dems Ag Caucus President

heading: issues
text: Florida's Department of Agriculture is about more than agriculture. It protects our food supply, our consumers, our natural resources, and the communities that make Florida home. My priorities are simple: protect our farms, protect consumers, and preserve Florida for future generations.
